# Numerical comparison fixtures

These UTF-8 files contain numerical inputs and outputs used to compare the
rewrite with inspected original functions. Test source identifies the relevant
function addresses and the interpretation of each row. The `.f8` fixture is
camera/report metadata. No original assets, executable bytes, original shader
sources, decompiled code or screenshots belong here.

Fixtures previously lived in the ignored local `analysis/` directory. Keep
reproducible cases here, and keep capture tools and private evidence outside the
published source. Normal tests must not depend on local research files.
